hardware_local.purpose: C/API microbenchmarks and sanitizers only; no local Minecraft server

tests.precommit: make -B precommit-check GOATWORLD_G1_CHECK=1 passed on fresh remote stage

caveats: Medians of three independent per-run quantiles; not pooled quantiles.
busy metrics also include fast actions between scheduled ticks.
write/pwrite counts include deferred saves through shutdown, not restart verification.
Linux process write_bytes is not a physical RAID/controller measurement.
File highwater is sampled at 250 ms and may miss short peaks.
Placement/break work is equal; incidental pickups vary with timing and are recorded per observer, not summed as unique pickups.
No globally cold OS/device caches; startup integrity_check reads the database.

discarded_pilots.reason: 64-bit codec metadata truncated before validation; reproduced, fixed; entire 36-run benchmark repeated
pickup test waited for view-distance 10 but runner configured 2; corrected test configuration
restart QA query sent by non-admin observer correctly denied; fixed harness, no permission change
initial C eviction test used budget zero; test corrected before final qualification

limitations: No constant 20 TPS claim; tick+fast overruns and Python saturation recorded.
OS/device caches not purged; integrity_check warms database before chunk loads.
Full integrity_check startup and million-chunk worlds not qualified.
32,768-frame WAL backpressure not stress-saturated; pinned-reader BUSY and queue saturation tested.
SIGKILL and deterministic I/O errors do not establish physical power-loss/RAID controller guarantees.
No atomic transaction across chunks, players, inventories and dropped items.
No migration, converter, principal deployment, gameplay change or default change.
Vanilla comparison covers represented states, not direct Vanilla readability of SQLite.
